name: Lolnar
description: Lolnar was a planet located in the Lolnar system, in the Slice portion of the Core Worlds that was known as the Arrowhead. It was situated on the Corellian Run super-hyperroute, between the Perma and Rehemsa systems. The Human Lesan Ramier, who was a Moff of the Galactic Empire, hailed from Lolnar.
